sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from a recent loss. Despite that setback, Sandbach remain firmly at the top with 22 points from 10 games and a strong record of 7 wins, 1 draw and 2 losses. They face an Alsager Town side in poor form at the bottom of the table with just 4 points, so should be confident of returning to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them cut the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, host fifth-placed Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two in-form sides. Fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals welcome struggling Wednesfield Community to what looks like an opportunity to climb further up the standings. Bilston Town entertain Foley Meir in a match between sides mid-table, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter enduring a dire run of six consecutive defeats. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to face New Mills, both sides fighting to escape the lower reaches of the table. Market Drayton Town welcome bottom-dweller Widnes Town, who have managed just 2 points from 7 games. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement battle between teams with 9 and 11 points respectively. Finally, Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town in what should be a winnable fixture for the home side.
